name: Passenger Vehicle/Loading Vehicle Loan Scheme (DAADC)
benefit: - Financial assistance in the form of a loan.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. - The applicant must be unemployed. - The applicant must belong to an Antyodaya family. - The applicant must have a family income not exceeding ₹3,00,000/- per annum.
